ConditionTab.Label: Condition
ConditionTab.Heading: Active Effect condition
ConditionTab.Hint: Use JavaScript. This Active Effect is applied only when the script returns true.
ConditionTab.CompatibilityHint: This condition came from DAE. SC Conditional AE is adapting it automatically.
ConditionTab.VariableToolbarHint: Search for a variable and insert it at the current cursor position.

Evaluation.Heading: Current evaluation
Evaluation.Empty: No condition configured. The effect is available.
Evaluation.True: The condition currently resolves to true. The effect is available.
Evaluation.False: The condition currently resolves to false. The effect is unavailable.
Evaluation.Error: The condition threw an error while being evaluated.

Summary.Heading: Condition status
Summary.EffectGate: The effect-wide condition is {state}, so this change stays suppressed.
Summary.OpenEffectHint: Open the conditions for the whole Active Effect.
Summary.OpenChangeHint: Open the conditions for this change only.

ConditionTab.BadgeLabelHint: Optional custom label for the condition status badge. Leave blank to use the default label.
ConditionTab.SuppressedTooltip: Condition not met. This effect is enabled, but its changes are currently suppressed.
ConditionTab.SuppressedErrorTooltip: Condition evaluation failed. This effect's changes are suppressed to prevent an unsafe application.
ConditionTab.DisabledManagedTooltip: Condition not met. This effect was disabled by its condition and will re-enable automatically once the condition is met.
ConditionTab.DisabledTooltip: Condition not met. This effect is disabled; even if enabled, its changes would stay suppressed until the condition is met.
ConditionTab.ConditionBehavior: When the condition is not met
ConditionTab.ConditionBehaviorHint: Choose whether to keep the Active Effect enabled while suppressing its changes, or synchronize its disabled state with the condition.
ConditionTab.SpatialConditionBehaviorHint: Conditions that use token or lightLevel always suppress changes locally. They never persist the Active Effect's disabled state.
ConditionTab.ApplyBehaviorUpdateHint: Reapplies the current Active Effect on the target instead of creating a new one.
ConditionTab.ApplyBehaviorDuplicateHint: Adds a new Active Effect instead of updating the existing one.
ConditionTab.ApplyBehaviorDaeHint: Uses DAE's Stackable setting to decide whether the effect stacks.

VariableDescription.change: The individual Active Effect change, or null for an effect-wide condition.
VariableDescription.changeId: The stable ID of the individual change, or null for an effect-wide condition.
VariableDescription.actor: The actor that owns the Active Effect.
VariableDescription.token: The affected actor's canvas token, or null when unavailable.
VariableDescription.lightLevel: Light under the token: bright, dim, dark, or null when unavailable.
VariableDescription.item: The item that owns the Active Effect, when there is one.
VariableDescription.origin: The document the Active Effect originated from.
VariableDescription.originActor: The actor that originated the Active Effect.
VariableDescription.rollData: Roll data resolved from the owning actor.
VariableDescription.source: The source data of the Active Effect.
VariableDescription.getProperty: Reads a nested property from an object by path.
VariableDescription.hasProperty: Checks whether a nested property path exists.
VariableDescription.deepClone: Returns a deep copy of a value.

AdvancedConditions.Title: Active Effect Conditions
AdvancedConditions.Invalid: Correct the invalid condition before saving.
AdvancedConditions.SaveFailed: The conditions could not be saved.
AdvancedConditions.OpenFromNative: Edit the JavaScript condition from the Advanced Conditions tab in the native condition editor.

Builder.ValueHint: Values accept JSON literals. Strings are shown in quotes so values such as "5" remain text; unquoted 5 is a number.
Builder.InvalidJson: Correct the JSON before opening the visual builder.

AdvancedConditions.EvaluationInfo: What each condition layer resolves to right now, against the effect's current actor. It only applies when every row is met; filters that read roll data can only be decided during a roll.

MacroChange.Name: Macro to Execute
MacroChange.Description: Execute a world macro when this Active Effect is applied or removed. Value format: macro name or UUID, followed by optional arguments.

FormulaChange.DialogHint: Confirm or edit the formula to roll for this Active Effect.
FormulaChange.ChatCardHint: This effect's formulas are ready to roll.
FormulaChange.ChatCardIntroCondition: The condition for {effect} has been met.
FormulaChange.ChatCardPrompt: Do you want to roll now?
FormulaChange.ChatCardReasonActivation: {effect} is active, and its formulas can be rolled now.
FormulaChange.ChatCardReasonCondition: {effect} is ready, and its formulas can be rolled now.
FormulaChange.SaveFailed: The formula could not be saved.
FormulaChange.ColumnHint: Formula rolled when this Active Effect is activated.
FormulaChange.EditorOpenHint: Open the formula editor to browse the available variables.
FormulaChange.EditorHint: Formula rolled when this Active Effect is activated. Leave it blank to remove the formula.
FormulaChange.PreviewEmpty: No formula. This change keeps its own value.
FormulaChange.PreviewNoActor: This Active Effect has no actor yet, so roll data is unavailable here.
FormulaChange.ToggleValueMode: Switch between a fixed value and a formula.
FormulaChange.OrphanedFormula: Formulas on "{effect}" no longer match a change and were skipped: {keys}.
FormulaChange.OrphanedFormulaHint: Some formulas on this effect no longer match a change and will be skipped: {keys}.

EnableFormulaChanges.Name: Enable formula fields
EnableFormulaChanges.Hint: Adds formula fields to Active Effect changes and rolls formulas when effects are activated.

UseFormulaChatCard.Name: Post formula roll chat card
UseFormulaChatCard.Hint: Whenever a conditional effect becomes available, or when a formula-backed Active Effect is activated, post a chat card so the roll can be triggered from chat instead of immediately.

ShowConditionTab.Name: Show condition tab
ShowConditionTab.Hint: Adds the Condition tab to Active Effect configuration sheets.
ShowConditionTab.DaeNotice: If you use Dynamic Active Effects (DAE) with the condition tab enabled, a libWrapper conflict warning may appear in the browser console. This is expected — the module intentionally blocks effect application when a condition is not met, which also skips DAE's wrapper for those effects. You can safely ignore this warning.

TintEffectIcons.Name: Tint effect icons
TintEffectIcons.Hint: Paints each Active Effect's Icon Tint Color onto its icon in effect lists. Effects left at the default white are unchanged.

DebugLogging.Name: Enable debug logging
DebugLogging.Hint: Logs condition evaluation, suppression refreshes, and activation transitions to the browser console.
